entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin ba shi da hauhawar farashi

entries.englishValue: Inflation means your money buys you less over time. Bitcoin is better money because it doesn't have inflation.
entries.targetTranslation: Hauhawar farashi tana nufin kuɗinka yana sayen ƙasa da lokaci. Bitcoin kuɗi ne mafi kyau saboda ba shi da hauhawar farashi.

entries.englishValue: because it has a maximum supply of 21 million Bitcoin. No one can print more Bitcoin.

entries.englishValue: Bitcoin is scarce

entries.englishValue: Historically, Bitcoin has gained purchasing power over time while the dollar has lost it. Many people use Bitcoin as their long-term savings account: money that they can leave alone and let grow for several years.
entries.targetTranslation: A tarihi, Bitcoin ya samu ikon saye da lokaci, yayin da dalar Australia ya rasa nasa. Mutane da yawa suna amfani da Bitcoin a matsayin asusun adana kuɗi na dogon lokaci — kuɗi da suke barin yana girma na shekaru ba tare da taɓawa ba.

entries.englishValue: Would you rather save in dollars that buy you less over time? Or save in Bitcoin that has historically bought you more over time?
entries.targetTranslation: Shin ka fi son adana kuɗi a dalar Australia, wanda ke sayen ƙasa da lokaci? Ko kuma a Bitcoin, wanda a tarihi ya samu ƙarin ikon saye da lokaci?

entries.englishValue: Bitcoin is also a tool for freedom
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin kuma kayan aiki ne na 'yanci

entries.englishValue: The Bitcoin network isn't owned by anyone. It isn't controlled by any government or corporation. It's designed to uphold your freedom and protect your money.
entries.targetTranslation: Babu wanda ke kula da hanyar sadarwar Bitcoin. Babu gwamnati ko kamfani da ke gudanar da ita. An ƙera ta don kare 'yancinka da kuɗinka.

entries.englishValue: People around the world are already using Bitcoin to protect their freedom — even when their own governments refused to help or tried to stop them.
entries.targetTranslation: A duk faɗin duniya, mutane suna amfani da Bitcoin tuni don kare 'yancinsu — har ma lokacin da gwamnatocinsu suka ƙi taimaka musu ko sun yi ƙoƙarin tsayar da su.

entries.englishValue: If you save in Australian Dollars, you've probably noticed that they buy you less each year. It takes more dollars to buy the same amount of food. You need more dollars to maintain your quality of life.
entries.targetTranslation: Idan kana adana kuɗi a dalar Australia, watakila ka lura cewa kuɗinka yana sayen ƙasa kowace shekara. Kana buƙatar ƙarin dalolin Australia don sayen abubuwa iri ɗaya. Kana buƙatar ƙarin dalolin Australia don kiyaye matsayinka na rayuwa.

entries.englishValue: But it doesn't have to be this way.
entries.targetTranslation: Amma ba lallai ne ya kasance haka ba.

entries.englishValue: People who saved in Bitcoin over the last 4 years saw life get cheaper.
entries.targetTranslation: A cikin shekaru huɗu da suka gabata, mutanen da suke adana kuɗi a Bitcoin suna jin daɗin rayuwa mai sauƙi.

entries.englishValue: The dollars in your bank account buy you less every year. That's because there is no fixed limit on how many dollars can be created.

entries.englishValue: This unlimited supply is the root cause of inflation. Over recent years, the total amount of dollars in existence has increased dramatically.
entries.targetTranslation: Wannan iyakar da ba ta da iyaka ita ce babban dalilin hauhawar farashi. A cikin shekaru kaɗan da suka gabata, an samu ƙaruwa mai yawa a adadin dalolin Australia da ke yawo.

entries.targetTranslation: Bankuna na iya ƙin, daskarewa, ko rufe asusun bisa ga dokokinsu ko ƙa'idoji.

entries.englishValueBefore: The Bitcoin network operates 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, 365 days a year without maintenance windows or holidays. Banks have limited operating hours, close on weekends and holidays, and often have system maintenance periods when services are unavailable.
entries.englishValue: The Bitcoin network runs 24/7/365 with no maintenance windows or holidays. Banks have limited hours, weekends off, and outage windows.
entries.currentValue: Bankuna suna ajiye ɓangaren kuɗin tallafin masu ajiya kawai. Bitcoin tsarin ajiye na cikakke ne — bitcoinka na nan ne idan ka ajiye shi a walletka.
entries.targetTranslation: Hanyar sadarwar Bitcoin tana aiki sa'o'i 24 a rana, kwanaki 7 a mako, kwanaki 365 a shekara ba tare da tagogin kulawa ko ranakun hutu ba. Bankuna suna da iyakacin sa'o'i, suna rufewa a ƙarshen mako kuma suna fuskantar gazawar aiki.

entries.englishValueBefore: All Bitcoin transactions are recorded on a public blockchain that anyone can verify and audit.
entries.englishValue: Every Bitcoin transaction is on a public blockchain anyone can audit. Banks run private ledgers customers can't independently verify.
entries.currentValue: Bankuna suna aiki a lokutan aiki na ƙayyadaddun. Bitcoin yana aiki 24 sa'o'i, 7 kwanaki, 365 rana a shekara.
entries.targetTranslation: Kowace ma'amalar Bitcoin ana yin rikodi a kan blockchain na jama'a wanda kowa zai iya tabbatarwa. Bankuna suna riƙe litattafan asusu na sirri waɗanda abokan ciniki ba za su iya bincika ba da kansu.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin transaction fees are transparent, predictable, and typically very low. Banks often have hidden fees, monthly account fees, overdraft charges, wire transfer fees, ATM fees, and other penalties that can add up significantly over time.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin fees are transparent and predictable. Banks stack on hidden account, overdraft, wire, and ATM fees over time.
entries.currentValue: Bankuna suna buƙatar cikakken bayanai don buɗe asusun. Kowa zai iya amfani da Bitcoin ba tare da izini ba.
entries.targetTranslation: Kuɗin Bitcoin a bayyane suke kuma a iya hango. Bankuna suna tara kuɗi ɓoye akai-akai don asusun ajiya, wuce-gona-da-iri, canja wuri da ATM.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin prevents you from spending money you don't have - you can only spend Bitcoin that you actually own. Banks allow overdrafts (spending more than your account balance) and then charge substantial fees for this 'service,' often leading to cascading penalty charges.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin only lets you spend what you actually own. Banks allow overdrafts, then charge cascading penalty fees for the privilege.
entries.currentValue: Bankuna suna binciken ma'amala kuma za su iya ƙi su. Bitcoin yana amfani da tabbaci na lissafi maimakon izinin mutane.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin yana ba ka damar kashe abin da kake da shi kawai. Bankuna suna ba da damar wuce-gona-da-iri sannan suna cajin ka jerin kuɗin hukunci.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin transactions are censorship resistant - once broadcast to the network, they cannot be stopped or reversed by any central authority. Banks can block, freeze, reverse, or restrict transactions based on their policies, government orders, or suspicious activity algorithms.
entries.englishValue: Once broadcast, Bitcoin transactions can't be stopped or reversed. Banks can block, freeze, or reverse transactions based on policy or government orders.
entries.currentValue: Gwamnatoci za su iya kwace kuɗin bankinka. Ba za a iya kwace Bitcoin ba idan kana kula da shi a walletka da kanka.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bonds are only 'risk-free' in nominal dollar terms, meaning you'll get your dollars back if you hold to maturity. However, this ignores inflation risk, interest rate risk, and the possibility that those dollars will be worth much less when you get them back.
entries.englishValue: Bonds are only 'risk-free' nominally — inflation, interest-rate moves, and default risk all eat real returns.
entries.currentValue: Takardun bashi 'mara haɗari' ne a suna kawai — za ka sami daloli na baya, amma za su iya zama da ƙarancin daraja sosai.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin has clear, transparent risks (volatility) but no hidden counterparty risk - you either own your Bitcoin or you don't.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin has transparent volatility but no hidden counterparty risk.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin can be sent anywhere in the world instantly over the Internet, while cash requires physical presence or trusted intermediaries. You can't email cash, but you can send Bitcoin to anyone with an Internet connection in minutes.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin moves over the internet anywhere in minutes. Cash needs physical presence or trusted couriers — you can't email a $20 bill.
entries.currentValue: Za a iya aika Bitcoin ko'ina a duniya nan take ta Intanet, yayin da tsabar kuɗi yana buƙatar kasancewa a zahiri.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin yana tafiya ko'ina a duniya ta hanyar intanet, a cikin daƙiƙa. Kuɗin tsabar yana buƙatar kasancewar zahiri ko amintattun manzanni — ba za ka iya aika takardar ashirin ta imel ba.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin works the same way everywhere in the world - there are no borders in the Bitcoin network. Cash is limited by geography, exchange rates, and local acceptance. Try using US dollars in rural Thailand or Japanese yen in rural Mexico.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin works the same way everywhere. Cash is limited by geography, exchange rates, and local acceptance.

entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin yana aiki iri ɗaya ko'ina. Kuɗin tsabar yana iyakancewa ta yanayi, ƙimar musanya da karɓuwa ta cikin gida.

entries.englishValueBefore: Cash can be counterfeited, and it's often difficult to detect fake bills without special equipment. Even with security features, counterfeit cash continues to circulate. Bitcoin uses cryptographic proof that makes counterfeiting mathematically impossible.
entries.englishValue: Cash can be counterfeited, sometimes convincingly. Bitcoin uses cryptography that makes counterfeiting mathematically impossible.
entries.currentValue: Za a iya jabu tsabar kuɗi, kuma galibi yana da wahalar ganin jabu. Bitcoin yana amfani da tabbaci na lissafi wanda ke sa jabu ya zama ba zai yiwu ba ta fuskar lissafi.

entries.englishValueBefore: Cash is issued and controlled by governments, who can print more at will, change designs, or declare certain bills invalid. Bitcoin operates on a decentralized network where no single authority has control over the money supply or rules.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin has no central authority. Cash is issued by governments that can print more, change designs, or invalidate notes at will.

entries.englishValue: Bitcoin is the most secure computing network ever built and has never been hacked. CBDCs rely on banks and governments that have been hacked countless times.

entries.englishValue: Bitcoin addresses aren't tied to your real identity. CBDCs link directly to government ID, enabling mass financial surveillance and censorship.

entries.englishValue: Bitcoin's rules are validated by tens of thousands of independent nodes. CBDCs are centralized in government and central-bank hands, which hold complete control over the network.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin allows anyone to run a node that verifies the rules of the network are being followed. CBDCs don't allow anyone to run nodes and rely on trust in the government and central banks.
entries.englishValue: Anyone can run a Bitcoin node to verify the rules of the network. CBDCs don't allow users to run nodes — you have to trust the central authority.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin's protocol has remained fundamentally unchanged since 2009, providing predictable rules that cannot be easily altered. Most crypto projects frequently update their protocols, change tokenomics, or fork into new versions, creating uncertainty for users.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin's protocol has stayed fundamentally the same since 2009, providing predictable rules. Most crypto projects constantly change protocols, tokenomics, or fork into new versions.
entries.currentValue: Tsarin Bitcoin ya kasance ba ya canzawa ta asali tun 2009. Yawancin ayyukan crypto suna sabunta tsare-tsarensu akai-akai.
entries.targetTranslation: Yarjejeniyar Bitcoin ba ta canza sosai ba tun 2009 kuma tana ba da dokokin da za a iya hango. Yawancin ayyukan crypto suna canza yarjejeniya, tokenomics ko makasudi a sabbin sigogi akai-akai.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin operates on a truly decentralized network with tens of thousands of independent nodes worldwide. Many crypto projects are controlled by foundations, companies, or small groups of developers who can make unilateral decisions about the protocol's future.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin runs on tens of thousands of independent nodes worldwide. Most crypto projects are controlled by foundations, companies, or small dev teams that can make unilateral changes.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin yana aiki a cibiyar sadarwa mai rarrabawa da gaske tare da dubban dubban nodes masu zaman kansu. Yawancin ayyukan crypto suna ƙarƙashin gudanarwar gidauniyoyi ko ƙananan ƙungiyoyin masu haɓaka.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin yana gudana akan dubban nodes masu zaman kansu a duniya. Yawancin ayyukan crypto suna sarrafa su ta gidauniyoyi, kamfanoni ko ƙananan ƙungiyoyin masu haɓakawa waɗanda za su iya yin canje-canje na ɓangare ɗaya.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin has a hard cap of 21 million coins that will ever exist, making it the scarcest digital asset. Most crypto projects have unlimited supplies, inflationary mechanisms, or can mint new tokens at will, diluting holder value over time.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin has a hard cap of 21 million coins — the scarcest digital asset. Most crypto projects have unlimited supplies or mechanisms to mint new tokens at will, diluting holders.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin yana da iyakar 21 miliyan tsabar kuɗi. Yawancin ayyukan crypto suna da tanadi mara iyaka ko za su iya ƙirƙirar sababbin tokens a kowane lokaci.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin yana da iyaka mai ƙayyadewa na tsabar miliyan 21 — kadarar dijital mafi ƙanƙanci. Yawancin ayyukan crypto suna da wadata mara iyaka ko hanyoyin ƙirƙirar sabbin tokens da gangan, abin da ke tarwatsa masu mallaka.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin has one simple purpose: peer-to-peer digital money. Anyone can understand and use it with basic knowledge. Many crypto projects involve complex smart contracts, DeFi protocols, or governance mechanisms that require technical expertise to use safely.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin has one purpose: peer-to-peer digital money. Anyone can understand and use it. Most crypto involves complex smart contracts or DeFi that require technical expertise to use safely.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin yana da manufa ɗaya mai sauƙi: kuɗi na dijital na mutum-zuwa-mutum. Yawancin ayyukan crypto masu rikitarwa ne.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin yana da manufa ɗaya: kuɗin dijital tsakanin tsara-tsara. Kowa zai iya fahimtarsa kuma ya yi amfani da shi. Yawancin crypto suna haɗawa da kwangiloli masu sarƙaƙƙiya ko DeFi waɗanda ke buƙatar ƙwarewar fasaha don amfani da su lafiya.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin uses Proof of Work consensus, which has been battle-tested for over 15 years without a single successful attack on the main network. Many crypto projects use experimental consensus mechanisms like Proof of Stake or delegated systems that haven't proven their long-term security.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin's Proof of Work has run without a successful attack on the main network for over 15 years. Most crypto projects use experimental consensus that hasn't been battle-tested.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin yana amfani da tabbacin aiki, wanda aka gwada cikin nasara fiye da shekaru 15. Yawancin ayyukan crypto suna amfani da hanyoyi na gwaji.
entries.targetTranslation: Proof of Work na Bitcoin yana aiki ba tare da nasarar harin a kan babban sarƙa fiye da shekaru 15 ba. Yawancin ayyukan crypto suna amfani da hanyoyin yarjejeniya na gwaji da ba a gwada su sosai ba.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin serves as digital money - a store of value and medium of exchange. Most crypto tokens are utility tokens for specific platforms, governance tokens, or speculative assets with unclear real-world value propositions.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin is digital money — a store of value and medium of exchange. Most crypto tokens are speculative utility or governance tokens with unclear real-world value.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin yana aiki a matsayin kuɗi na dijital — mai ajiye daraja da kayan musayar. Yawancin crypto tokens na amfani ne ko na tsammanin.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin kuɗin dijital ne — ma'ajiyar daraja da hanyar musayya. Yawancin tokens na crypto sune tokens na hasashe na amfani ko mulki waɗanda ba su da bayyananniyar daraja ta gaske.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin becomes stronger under attack and has survived every crisis, ban, and criticism thrown at it. Most crypto projects are fragile and can collapse from regulatory pressure, technical failures, or market downturns.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin grows stronger under attack and has survived every crisis, ban, and criticism. Most crypto projects collapse under regulatory, technical, or market pressure.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin yana ƙara ƙarfi daga hare-hare kuma ya tsira daga kowane rikici. Yawancin ayyukan crypto masu rauni ne kuma za su iya rushe.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin ya yi ƙarfi a ƙarƙashin hare-hare kuma ya tsira daga kowane rikici, hani da suka. Yawancin ayyukan crypto suna faɗuwa a ƙarƙashin matsin lamba na tsari, fasaha ko kasuwa.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin has no CEO, no company behind it, and no single point of failure. Many crypto projects are backed by venture capital firms, have identifiable leadership teams, or depend on specific companies for their continued operation.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin has no CEO, no company, no single point of failure. Most crypto projects depend on VCs, specific leadership, or one company's survival.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin ba shi da shugaban kamfani, babu kamfani a bayansa kuma babu wurin gazawa ɗaya. Yawancin ayyukan crypto masu saka jari ne ke tallafa musu.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin ba shi da CEO, kamfani ko wani wuri ɗaya na gazawa. Yawancin ayyukan crypto sun dogara da masu saka jari na haɗari, jagoranci na musamman ko rayuwar kamfani guda.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin is perfectly fungible, meaning every bitcoin is identical and interchangeable - one bitcoin equals one bitcoin anywhere in the world. Fine art is non-fungible by nature, with each piece being unique in its creation, history, condition, and provenance, making direct comparisons and valuations extremely difficult.
entries.englishValue: Every bitcoin is identical and interchangeable. Every artwork is unique — different creation, history, condition, and provenance make direct comparisons extremely difficult.
entries.currentValue: Kowanne bitcoin iri ɗaya ne kuma ana iya musayar. Fasaha ta musamman ce ta dabi'a, wanda ke sa ƙima ta zama da wahala sosai.
entries.targetTranslation: Kowane bitcoin daidai yake kuma ana iya musanya. Kowane aiki na fasaha na musamman ne — asali, tarihi, yanayi da zuriya daban-daban suna sa kwatancen kai tsaye yana da matuƙar wahala.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin trades on a global 24/7 market where anyone with internet access can buy or sell instantly. Fine art requires specialized auction houses like Sotheby's or Christie's, private dealers, or exclusive galleries. Sales can take months to arrange and complete, with limited market access and irregular trading opportunities.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin trades 24/7 on a global market accessible to anyone. Fine art requires specialized auction houses, private dealers, or galleries and can take months to sell.
entries.currentValue: Ana ciniki da Bitcoin a kasuwannin duniya 24/7. Fasaha tana buƙatar gidajen gwanjo na musamman kuma sayarwa na iya ɗaukar watanni.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin yana ciniki sa'o'i 24 a rana a kasuwa ta duniya da ake samuwa ga kowa. Fasaha mai daraja tana buƙatar gidajen gwanjo na musamman, dillalai masu zaman kansu ko gallery, kuma sayarwa zai iya ɗaukar watanni.

entries.englishValueBefore: Buying or selling bitcoin typically costs less than 1% in fees, often much less. Fine art sales involve substantial costs including buyer's premiums (10-25%), seller's commissions (10-15%), insurance, transportation, storage, and authentication fees. These combined costs can easily exceed 30-40% of the artwork's value in a single transaction.
entries.englishValue: Buying or selling Bitcoin costs under 1% in fees, often much less. Art sales rack up 30–40% in buyer's premiums, commissions, insurance, transport, and authentication fees.
entries.currentValue: Siye ko sayar da Bitcoin galibi yana ɗaukar ƙasa da 1%. Cinikin fasaha yana ɗauke da kuɗin da za su iya wucewa 30-40%.
entries.targetTranslation: Yana kashe ƙasa da 1% a cikin kuɗi don saye ko sayar da Bitcoin, sau da yawa ƙasa sosai. Sayar da fasaha tana tara 30-40% a cikin kwamishinan masu siye, kuɗi, inshora, jigilar kaya da kuɗin tabbatar da gaskiya.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin can be divided into 100 million smaller units called satoshis, making it perfect for transactions of any size from microtransactions to large purchases. Fine art cannot be divided - you cannot own a fraction of a painting or sell just part of a sculpture. This indivisibility limits investment flexibility and liquidity options.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin divides into 100 million sats, making it perfect for any size transaction. You can't own a fraction of a painting or a corner of a sculpture without counterparty risk.
entries.currentValue: Za a iya raba Bitcoin zuwa sassa 100 miliyan. Ba za a iya raba fasaha ba.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin za a iya raba shi har zuwa satoshi miliyan 100, abin da ke sa shi cikakke don ma'amaloli na kowane girma. Ba za ka iya mallakar ɓangaren zane ko kusurwar mutum-mutumi ba tare da haɗarin sashi.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin ownership and authenticity can be cryptographically verified on the blockchain by anyone with basic technical knowledge. Fine art requires expensive expert authentication, provenance research, and scientific analysis. Even with expert verification, forgeries regularly fool the art world, and authentication disputes can destroy an artwork's value overnight. Bitcoin, on the other hand, cannot be forged or counterfeited.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin ownership and authenticity can be cryptographically verified by anyone on-chain. Art authentication is expensive, slow, and still routinely fooled by forgers — destroying an artwork's value overnight.
entries.currentValue: Ana iya tabbatar da mallakar Bitcoin da ingancin sa ta lissafi. Fasaha tana buƙatar tsadar binciken kwararru, kuma jabun suna yaudara cikin duniyar fasaha akai-akai.
entries.targetTranslation: Mallaka da gaskiyar Bitcoin za a iya tabbatar da su ta hanyar cryptography ta kowa a kan blockchain. Tabbatar da ayyukan fasaha yana da tsada, yana ɗaukar lokaci, kuma ana yaudarar masana akai-akai — yana lalata darajar aiki cikin dare.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin, when backed up properly, cannot be destroyed by floods, fires, earthquakes, hurricanes, theft, or other disasters. Fine art is vulnerable to all forms of physical destruction and deterioration. Even with expensive climate-controlled storage and comprehensive insurance, artworks can be damaged by environmental factors, accidents, or natural disasters, potentially losing all value.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin, backed up properly, survives floods, fires, earthquakes, and theft. Fine art is vulnerable to every form of physical destruction, and insurance rarely covers it all.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin ba zai iya lalacewa ba idan an yi adana madadin daidai. Fasaha tana da rauni ga duk wani lalacewar zahiri.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin da aka adana yadda ya kamata zai iya tsira daga ambaliyar ruwa, gobara, girgizar ƙasa da sata. Fasaha mai daraja tana cikin haɗari ga duk nau'ikan bala'o'i na zahiri, kuma inshora ba ya rufe komai sau da yawa.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin can be bought and sold by anyone with internet access and a small amount of money to invest. Fine art investment is largely limited to wealthy collectors due to high minimum prices, exclusive auction access, storage requirements, insurance costs, and the specialized knowledge needed to navigate the art market successfully.
entries.englishValue: Anyone with an internet connection and a little money can buy Bitcoin. Fine art investment is effectively limited to wealthy collectors with auction access and specialized knowledge.
entries.currentValue: Kowa mai haɗin Intanet zai iya siyan Bitcoin. Saka jari a fasaha an ƙayyadaddhe ga attajiran masu tattarawa.
entries.targetTranslation: Kowa da ke da haɗin intanet da ƙananan kuɗi zai iya saye Bitcoin. Zuba jari a fasaha mai amfani galibi don masu tarawa masu arziki da ke da damar zuwa gwanji da ƙwarewar musamman.

entries.englishValueBefore: Because Bitcoin is digital, it can be sent almost instantly for very low fees by anyone with an Internet connection. Because Gold is physical, it cannot be moved across the Internet and must be physically shipped to transfer ownership.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin can be sent instantly over the internet for low fees. Gold must be physically shipped to transfer ownership.
entries.currentValue: Saboda Bitcoin na dijital ne, kowa mai haɗin Intanet na iya aika shi kusan nan take da ƙananan kuɗin aiki. Saboda Zinari na zahiri ne, ba za a iya tura shi ta Intanet ba kuma dole ne a aika shi ta zahiri don canza mallakar.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin za a iya aika nan take ta hanyar intanet tare da ƙananan kuɗi. Dole ne a jigilar zinariya ta zahiri don canja mallakar.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin is a digitally native asset, which means you can transfer full ownership of it over the Internet. Some companies offer the ability to buy gold online without receiving the actual physical gold, instead trusting the company to hold the gold for you. This is more like a Digital IOU since you only own a promise from the company instead of the actual asset.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin is a digitally native asset you can transfer over the internet. Online gold is a Digital IOU — you only own a promise from a custodian, not the metal itself.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin kadara ce ta dijital asali, wanda ke nufin za ka iya canza cikakken mallakar ta Intanet. Wasu kamfanoni suna ba da damar siyan zinari ta yanar gizo ba tare da karɓar zinarin zahiri ba, a maimakon haka ka amince wa kamfanin ya ajiye zinarin a madadin ka. Wannan ya fi kama da Takardar Bashi ta Dijital tunda kana mallakar alkawarin kamfanin ne kawai maimakon kadara ta gaske.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin kadarar dijital ce ta asali wacce za ka iya canja wa kanka ta hanyar intanet. Zinariya akan layi IOU dijital ne — kana riƙe alkawari kawai daga mai kulawa, ba ƙarfen kansa ba.

entries.englishValueBefore: New gold supply is pulled out of the ground each year, resulting in inflation of the total supply. It's estimated that the total supply of gold increases by about 1.6% per year, which means your slice of the pie shrinks by 1.6% per year.
entries.englishValue: inflation
entries.currentValue: Ana fitar da sabon zinari daga ƙarƙashin ƙasa kowace shekara, wanda ke haifar da hauhawar tanadin gaba ɗaya. An kiyasta cewa tanadin zinari yana ƙaruwa da kusan 1.6% a shekara, wanda ke nufin rabonka na leda yana raguwa da 1.6% a shekara.

entries.englishValueBefore: This is less than fiat inflation, but still inflation.
entries.englishValue: — but still inflation.
entries.currentValue: Wannan ya fi ƙarancin hauhawar farashi ta fiat, amma har yanzu hauhawar farashi ce.
entries.targetTranslation: na kuɗin fiat, amma har yanzu hauhawar farashi ne.

entries.englishValueBefore: Gold has an elastic supply, meaning that as the price of gold rises, there is a greater incentive to mine more gold. This often puts downward pressure on the gold price as new mines come online.
entries.englishValue: When gold prices rise, more gold gets mined, pushing the price back down. Bitcoin's supply is inelastic — no matter how high the price goes, there will only ever be 21 million.
entries.currentValue: Zinari yana da tanadi mai sassauƙa, wanda ke nufin yayin da farashin zinari ya haura, akwai ƙarin ƙarfafawa don haƙo ƙarin zinari. Wannan galibi yana matsa farashin zinari ƙasa yayin da sababbin ma'adinai suka fara aiki.
entries.targetTranslation: Lokacin da farashin zinariya ya tashi, ana hakar zinariya da yawa, abin da ke ƙarewa rage farashin. Wadatar Bitcoin ba ta da sassauci — ko da farashin ya tashi sosai, miliyan 21 ne kawai za su kasance.

entries.englishValueBefore: The Bitcoin network is decentralized.
entries.englishValue: Tens of thousands of independent nodes validate the Bitcoin network. Most physical gold sits in a handful of large custodian vaults.
entries.currentValue: Cibiyar sadarwar Bitcoin mai rarrabawa ce.
entries.targetTranslation: Hanyar sadarwar Bitcoin ana tabbatar da ita ta dubban nodes masu zaman kansu. Yawancin zinariyar zahiri tana cikin manyan ɗakuna kaɗan.

entries.englishValueBefore: With Bitcoin, it's incredibly easy to verify that you have real Bitcoin by taking self-custody of your coins and running a full node.
entries.englishValue: Anyone can verify real Bitcoin by running a full node — it's just an app. Verifying physical gold requires melting it down; the inside could be tungsten.
entries.currentValue: Da Bitcoin, yana da sauƙi sosai a tabbatar cewa kana da Bitcoin na gaske ta hanyar kula da tsabar kuɗinka da kanka da gudanar da cikakken node.
entries.targetTranslation: Kowa zai iya tabbatar da gaskiyar Bitcoin ta hanyar gudanar da cikakken node — app ne kawai. Tabbatar da zinariya ta zahiri yana buƙatar narkewa; tungsten zai iya kasancewa a ciki.

entries.englishValueBefore: Just like there are 100 cents in 1 dollar, there are 100,000,000 sats in 1 Bitcoin. This enables Bitcoin to be used for all scales of purchases, including microtransactions as small as a few cents.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin divides into 100 million sats, making it perfect for any size purchase. Gold can't be easily divided for small transactions.
entries.currentValue: Kamar yadda akwai senti 100 a cikin dala 1, akwai sats 100,000,000 a cikin Bitcoin 1. Wannan yana ba da damar amfani da Bitcoin don kowane girman saye, ciki har da ƙananan ma'amaloli kamar senti kaɗan.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin za a iya raba shi har zuwa satoshi miliyan 100, abin da ke sa shi cikakke don sayan kowane girma. Zinariya ba za a iya raba ta cikin sauƙi don ƙananan ma'amaloli ba.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin can be moved anywhere in the world instantly over the internet. Real estate is permanently fixed to a specific location and cannot be relocated, making it vulnerable to local economic conditions, natural disasters, and political instability.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin moves anywhere in the world instantly. Real estate is fixed to one location and exposed to local economic, political, and natural risks.
entries.currentValue: Za a iya canja Bitcoin ko'ina nan take ta Intanet. Gidaje suna daure a wuri na dindindin.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin yana motsi nan take a duk faɗin duniya. Gidaje suna da alaƙa da wuri kuma suna cikin haɗarin tattalin arziki, siyasa da haɗarin muhalli na cikin gida.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin can be divided into 100 million smaller units called satoshis, making it perfect for transactions of any size. Real estate cannot be easily divided - you can't sell just the kitchen of your house or buy half a bedroom.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin divides into 100 million sats. Real estate can't be partly sold — you can't offload just the kitchen or buy half a bedroom.
entries.currentValue: Za a iya raba Bitcoin zuwa sassa 100 miliyan. Ba za a iya raba gidaje cikin sauƙi ba.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin za a iya raba shi har zuwa satoshi miliyan 100. Gidaje ba za a iya sayar da su a ɓangare ba — ba za ka iya sayar da ɗakin girki ba ko saye rabin ɗakin kwana ba.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin operates on a decentralized network that no government can control. Real estate is subject to extensive government regulation including rent control, eviction moratoriums, zoning laws, and eminent domain where governments can seize your property.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin operates on a decentralized network that no government can control. Real estate is heavily regulated — zoning, rent control, eminent domain, and seizure all apply.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin yana aiki a cibiyar sadarwa mai rarrabawa. Gidaje suna ƙarƙashin dokar gwamnati mai yawa.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin yana aiki a kan hanyar sadarwa mara tsakiya wadda babu wata gwamnati da za ta iya sarrafa. Gidaje ana sarrafa su sosai — yanki, kula da haya, sayarwar tilas da kamawa duk sun shafe shi.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin requires no maintenance - it exists as digital code on a network. Real estate requires constant upkeep including repairs, renovations, property management, insurance, and dealing with tenants if rented.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin requires no upkeep. Real estate demands repairs, renovations, insurance, property management, and tenant issues.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin ba ya buƙatar gyara. Gidaje suna buƙatar gyara na ci gaba.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin ba ya buƙatar wani kulawa. Gidaje suna buƙatar gyarawa, sake gyara, inshora, gudanar da masu haya da magance matsalolin masu haya.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin has no ongoing taxes - you only pay capital gains when you sell. Real estate is subject to annual property taxes that must be paid regardless of whether the property generates income, effectively forcing you to rent your own property from the government forever.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin has no ongoing taxes — you only pay capital gains when you sell. Real estate owes annual property taxes regardless of income.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin ba shi da haraji na ci gaba. Ana biyan harajin kadara na shekara-shekara a kan gidaje.
entries.targetTranslation: Babu kuɗin haraji na ci gaba akan Bitcoin — kana biyan harajin riba kawai akan sayarwa. Gidaje suna biyan harajin gida na shekara-shekara ba tare da la'akari da kuɗi ba.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin, when backed up properly, cannot be destroyed by floods, fires, earthquakes, hurricanes, or other natural disasters. Real estate is vulnerable to all forms of physical destruction and requires expensive insurance that may not fully cover losses.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin, backed up properly, survives fire, flood, and earthquake. Real estate is vulnerable to every disaster, and insurance rarely covers it all.

entries.englishValue: Bitcoin trades globally 24/7 by anyone with internet access. Real estate sales are limited to local buyers and can take months of paperwork to close.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin enables direct individual ownership without intermediaries, promoting financial sovereignty for everyone. Buying real estate as an investment beyond your primary residence contributes to the financialization of housing, treating homes as commodities rather than shelter. This drives up prices, reduces affordability for families, and contributes to the housing and homelessness crisis affecting many countries today.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin enables direct individual ownership for anyone. Buying real estate as an investment beyond your primary residence drives up housing prices, reducing affordability and fueling the housing crisis.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin yana ba da damar mallakar mutum ɗaya kai tsaye ba tare da masu shiga tsakani ba. Saka jari a gidaje bayan gidanka na zama yana haifar da canza gidaje zuwa saka jari, yana ƙara farashi kuma yana shafar ikon siye na gidaje.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin yana ba da damar mallaka kai tsaye da kowa. Sayan gidaje a matsayin saka jari fiye da gidan farko yana ƙara farashin gidaje, yana rage samuwar su kuma yana haifar da rikicin gidaje.

entries.englishValueBefore: When you own Bitcoin, you have direct ownership of the asset itself. When you own stocks, you own a share of a company, which means your investment depends on the company's performance, management decisions, and business success.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin is a direct asset you own outright. Stocks are shares in a company — their value depends on management, performance, and decisions you can't control.
entries.currentValue: Idan kana mallakar Bitcoin, kana da mallakar kai tsaye na kadara kanta. Idan kana mallakar hannun jari, kana mallakar rabo na kamfani, wanda ke nufin jarin ka ya dogara da aikin kamfanin, yanke shawara na gudanarwa, da nasarar kasuwanci.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin operates on a decentralized network with no single point of failure. Stock investments are subject to key person risk - if the CEO or other critical leaders leave, get sick, or make poor decisions, your investment can suffer significantly. Companies depend heavily on their leadership teams.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin has no CEO and no single point of failure. Stocks depend heavily on leadership — one bad decision or departure can tank the price.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin's price is determined purely by market supply and demand. Stock prices are often evaluated using P/E ratios (Price-to-Earnings), which show how much investors pay for each dollar of company earnings. High P/E ratios can indicate overvalued stocks, making it harder to determine fair value.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin's price comes from open global markets. Stock valuations rely on metrics like P/E ratios that can mask overpriced shares.

entries.englishValue: Bitcoin is an open network anyone can join and use without permission. Visa is a closed system controlled by financial institutions that can deny access — especially to the unbanked and underbanked.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin operates on a transparent blockchain where all transactions can be verified by anyone. Credit card networks operate as closed, proprietary systems where transaction details are hidden from public view.
entries.englishValue: Every Bitcoin transaction is on a public, auditable blockchain. Visa runs a closed, proprietary system where customers can't independently verify anything.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin yana aiki a blockchain mai ganuwa inda za a iya tabbatar da duk ma'amaloli. Cibiyoyin sadarwar katin kuɗi tsare-tsaren rufaffun ne.
entries.targetTranslation: Kowace ma'amalar Bitcoin ana yin rikodi a kan blockchain na jama'a kuma za a iya tabbatarwa. Visa tana gudanar da tsarin rufe da na mallaka inda abokan ciniki ba za su iya tabbatar da komai ba da kansu.

entries.englishValueBefore: Credit card companies can freeze accounts, block transactions, or deny service at any time. Bitcoin cannot be frozen or controlled by any central authority.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin can't be frozen by any central authority. Visa can freeze accounts, block transactions, or deny service at any time.
entries.currentValue: Kamfanonin katin kuɗi za su iya daskare asusuna ko dakatar da ma'amaloli a kowane lokaci. Ba za a iya daskare Bitcoin ba.
entries.targetTranslation: Babu wata hukumar tsakiya da za ta iya daskare Bitcoin. Visa za ta iya daskare asusu, toshe ma'amaloli ko ƙin sabis a kowane lokaci.

entries.englishValueBefore: Credit cards create debt that can accumulate high interest rates if not paid off quickly, sometimes exceeding 25% annually.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin is final-settlement — you can only spend what you own. Credit cards create debt with interest rates often over 25% a year.
entries.currentValue: Katin kuɗi yana ƙirƙirar bashi da ribar da za ta iya wucewa 25% a shekara.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin tsarin biya na ƙarshe ne — kana kashe abin da kake da shi kawai. Katunan kiredit suna haifar da bashi tare da ƙimar riba waɗanda sau da yawa suka wuce 25% a kowace shekara.

entries.englishValue: A plain-English guide to accepting Bitcoin in your books — hybrid wallets, cost basis, capital gains, and when to call an accountant.
entries.currentValue: Koyi yadda za ku rikoɗa biyan kuɗi na Bitcoin daidai a cikin lissafin kuɗin kasuwancinku.
entries.targetTranslation: Jagora mai sauƙi don lissafin kuɗin biyan Bitcoin — walat-walat masu cakuda, farashin tushe, ribar jari da lokacin da ya kamata ka ga lissafinka.

entries.englishValueBefore: Accepting Bitcoin has many benefits like accepting payments with lower fees & getting more customers.
entries.englishValue: The simplest way to accept Bitcoin is with a hybrid wallet that automatically sells 100% of the Bitcoin you receive for dollars (or your local currency) the instant a payment comes in.
entries.currentValue: Karɓar Bitcoin yana da fa'idodi da yawa, ciki har da karɓar kuɗi tare da ƙananan kuɗin aiki da samun sabbin abokan ciniki.
entries.targetTranslation: Hanya mafi sauƙi don karɓar Bitcoin ita ce yin amfani da walat mai cakuda wanda ke canza 100% na bitcoin da aka karɓa ta atomatik zuwa dala (ko kuɗin gida) da zarar an karɓi biyan.

entries.englishValueBefore: If you use a Hybrid Wallet from our Wallet Guide and automatically sell 100% of the Bitcoin you receive for dollars, you don't need to make any changes to your current accounting.
entries.englishValue: With this setup, your books look exactly like they do today — the final number is in dollars, every time. No cost basis, no capital gains, no new spreadsheets.
entries.currentValue: Idan kuna amfani da wallet mai haɗe-haɗe daga jagorancin wallet ɗinmu kuma kuna sayar da 100% na Bitcoin da kuka karɓa zuwa daloli ta atomatik, ba ku buƙatar canza komai a lissafin kuɗinku na yanzu.
entries.targetTranslation: Tare da wannan saitin, lissafin kuɗinka kamar yadda yake yau — adadin ƙarshe zai kasance a dala kowane lokaci. Babu farashin tushe, babu ribar jari, babu sabon ƙa'idar lissafi.

entries.englishValueBefore: Tracking your cost basis is going to be the biggest difference between accounting for dollars and accounting for Bitcoin. Even if you view your business entirely in terms of Bitcoin, you need to report the dollar value of each transaction on your taxes.
entries.englishValue: Some businesses choose to keep a portion of the Bitcoin they receive instead of auto-converting it all. If that's you, the main extra step is tracking your cost basis — the dollar value of each Bitcoin payment on the day you received it.
entries.currentValue: Bin diddigin farashin siya shine babban bambanci tsakanin lissafin kuɗi a daloli da Bitcoin. Ko da kuna tunani game da kasuwancinku a sharuddan Bitcoin kawai, kuna buƙatar ba da rahoton darajar dala na kowane ma'amala a filin harajin ku.
entries.targetTranslation: Wasu kasuwanci suna zaɓar riƙe wani ɓangare na Bitcoin da suke karɓa maimakon canza shi ta atomatik. Idan kana yin wannan, ƙarin matakin shi ne bin farashin tushe — darajar dala ta kowane biyan Bitcoin a ranar da aka karɓa.

entries.englishValueBefore: If you use QuickBooks, you can do this automatically using the Bitcoin Sync plugin.
entries.englishValue: Even if you think of your business entirely in Bitcoin, most tax authorities still want the dollar value reported. The good news: it's just two numbers per transaction — the amount of Bitcoin received and its dollar value on that day.
entries.currentValue: Idan kuna amfani da QuickBooks, kuna iya yin wannan ta atomatik tare da ƙarin Bitcoin Sync.
entries.targetTranslation: Ko da kana tunanin kasuwancinka a Bitcoin kawai, yawancin hukumomin haraji har yanzu suna buƙatar ka ba da rahoton darajar dala. Labari mai daɗi: lambobi biyu kawai ne kowace ma'amala — adadin Bitcoin da aka karɓa da darajar dala ta wannan ranar.

entries.targetTranslation: Yi amfani da kayan aikin da ke ƙasa don sarrafa neman farashi ta atomatik, don kada ka duba farashi kowace rana.

entries.englishValueBefore: Inflation happens when more money is printed or created from thin air. This makes your money worth less over time.
entries.englishValue: Inflation happens when more money is printed or created from thin air. That makes the money in your pocket worth less over time — and it's why prices keep going up year after year.
entries.currentValue: Hauhawar farashi tana faruwa ne idan aka buga ko ƙirƙiri ƙarin kuɗi daga wofi. Wannan yana sa kuɗinka su yi ƙarancin daraja da lokaci.
entries.targetTranslation: Hauhawar farashi tana faruwa lokacin da aka buga ƙarin kuɗi ko aka ƙirƙira shi daga komai. Yana sa kuɗin da ke aljihunka ya rasa darajarsa da lokaci — kuma shi ne dalilin da yasa farashi ke tashi shekara bayan shekara.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin has a fixed supply, which means no one can print more Bitcoin.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin has a fixed supply of 21 million coins. No government, bank, or company can print more of it. Your Bitcoin savings hold their value over time instead of quietly losing it.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin yana da tanadin daidaitaccen adadi, wanda ke nufin babu wanda zai iya buga ƙarin Bitcoin.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin yana da wadata mai ƙayyadewa na tsabar miliyan 21. Babu wata gwamnati, banki ko kamfani da zai iya ƙirƙirar ƙari. Adana kuɗinka a Bitcoin yana riƙe darajar tare da lokaci maimakon rasa shi a hankali.

entries.englishValueBefore: Multiple US banks have collapsed in the past few years due to bank runs.
entries.englishValue: Multiple U.S. banks have collapsed in recent years because of bank runs. When too many customers tried to withdraw at once, the banks didn't have the cash to pay everyone back.
entries.currentValue: Bankuna da dama a Amurka sun rushe saboda guguwar bankuna a cikin shekarun baya-bayan nan.
entries.targetTranslation: A cikin shekaru kaɗan da suka gabata, bankunan Amurka da yawa sun faɗi saboda gudun banki. Lokacin da abokan ciniki da yawa suka yi ƙoƙarin cire kuɗi a lokaci ɗaya, bankuna ba su da isasshen kuɗi don biya su gaba ɗaya.

entries.englishValueBefore: Instead of just holding your money for you, banks invest and lend out your money. If those investments don't do well, they don't have enough to pay you back.
entries.englishValue: Instead of just holding your money, banks lend and invest most of it. If those investments go bad — or if depositors lose confidence — the bank can fail, and your deposits can be frozen or lost.
entries.currentValue: Maimakon kawai ajiye kuɗinka, bankuna suna saka su da ba da rance. Idan waɗannan jarin sun gaza, ba su da isassun kuɗi su mayar maka da naka.
entries.targetTranslation: Maimakon riƙe kuɗinka kawai, bankuna suna ba da yawancinsu aro kuma suna saka jari. Idan waɗannan saka jarin sun gaza — ko kuma masu adana kuɗi sun rasa amincewa — bankin zai iya faɗuwa kuma ya daskare ko ya ɓata ajiyarka.

entries.englishValueBefore: And the FDIC insurance fund only has $1 for every $100 they're insuring.
entries.englishValue: With Bitcoin, you can hold your own money directly in your own wallet. No bank. No intermediary. No bank run.
entries.currentValue: Kuma asusun inshorar FDIC yana da dala 1 kawai a kowace dala 100 da suke inshorar su.
entries.targetTranslation: Tare da Bitcoin, za ka iya riƙe kuɗinka kai tsaye a walat ɗinka. Babu banki. Babu 'yan tsaka. Babu gudun banki.

entries.englishValueBefore: Unlike traditional financial networks, Bitcoin doesn't require permission to be used.
entries.englishValue: Unlike credit cards, PayPal, or traditional bank accounts, Bitcoin doesn't require anyone's permission to use.
entries.currentValue: Ba kamar hanyoyin kuɗi na gargajiya ba, Bitcoin ba ya buƙatar izini don amfani.
entries.targetTranslation: Ba kamar katunan kiredit, PayPal ko asusun banki na al'ada ba, Bitcoin ba ya neman izinin kowa.

entries.englishValueBefore: That means no one can stop you from using Bitcoin for any reason. It's the first financial network you can use without fear of censorship or seizure.
entries.englishValue: No one can freeze your account, block a payment, or cut you off from the network. It's the first financial system in history you can use freely, without fear of censorship or seizure.
entries.currentValue: Wannan yana nufin babu wanda zai iya hana ka amfani da Bitcoin saboda wani dalili. Shi ne cibiyar sadarwar kuɗi ta farko da za ka iya amfani da ita ba tare da tsoron tace-tace ko kwace ba.
entries.targetTranslation: Babu wanda zai iya daskare asusunka, toshe biyan kuɗi ko cire ka daga hanyar sadarwa. Tsarin kuɗi ne na farko a tarihi wanda za ka iya amfani da shi cikin yardar kaina, ba tare da tsoron takunkumi ko kwace ba.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin is a misunderstood technology that is building a better world.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin is often misunderstood, but it's quietly doing a lot of good in the world.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin fasaha ce da aka rashin fahimta wadda ke gina duniya mafi kyau.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin sau da yawa ba a fahimta ba, amma yana yin alheri da yawa a hankali a duk faɗin duniya.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin has enabled human rights activists to fight for freedom, reduced global methane emissions, saved national parks, and so much more.
entries.englishValue: It has helped human rights activists fight for freedom, reduced global methane emissions from landfills and oil fields, stabilized electric grids, and funded public goods like national parks.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin ya ba da damar masu fafutikar kare haƙƙin ɗan adam su yi faɗa don 'yanci, ya rage fitar da iskar methane a duniya, ya ceci wuraren shakatawa na ƙasa, da ƙari da yawa.
entries.targetTranslation: Ya taimaka wa masu kare haƙƙin ɗan adam a faɗansu na 'yanci, ya rage hayaƙin methane na duniya daga wuraren shara da rijiyoyin mai, ya tabbatar da hanyoyin sadarwa na lantarki kuma ya ba da kuɗin kayan jama'a kamar wuraren shakatawa na ƙasa.

entries.englishValue: Bitcoin doesn't have bank runs
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin ba shi da gudun banki

entries.englishValue: Bitcoin is a full-reserve system. You're not depositing your money in a bank. You are your own bank. There's no lending out your money without your knowledge because you are the only one who can access your money.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin tsarin cikakken ajiya ne. Ba ka sa kuɗinka a banki ba. Kai banki ne. Ba a ba da kuɗinka aro ba tare da saninka ba, saboda kai kaɗai ne ke da damar zuwa gareshi.

entries.englishValue: As long as you hold bitcoin in your own wallet — not on an exchange or wrapped in an ETF — bank runs are impossible.
entries.targetTranslation: Muddin ka adana bitcoin ɗinka a walat ɗinka — ba a kasuwanni ko ETF ba — gudun banki ba zai yiwu ba.

entries.englishValue: With Bitcoin, you're truly in control of your money.
entries.targetTranslation: Tare da Bitcoin, kana da iko na gaske akan kuɗinka.

entries.englishValue: Banks lend out your deposits under fractional reserve banking. If too many people withdraw at once, banks can fail. Bitcoin is a full-reserve system — bank runs are impossible.
entries.targetTranslation: Bankuna suna ba da kuɗinka aro ta hanyar tsarin ajiyar ɓangare. Idan mutane da yawa suka cire kuɗi a lokaci ɗaya, bankuna suna iya faɗuwa. Bitcoin tsarin cikakken ajiya ne — gudun banki ba zai yiwu ba.

entries.targetTranslation: Silicon Valley Bank: misali na rayuwar gaske

entries.englishValue: Thousands of businesses couldn't pay their employees. The FDIC stepped in — but that raised a bigger question: is your money actually safe?

entries.englishValue: Banks don't hold your deposits in a vault. They lend your money out and invest it — that's called fractional reserve banking.
entries.targetTranslation: Bankuna ba sa adana ajiyarka a cikin akwati mai aminci. Suna ba da aro kuma suna saka kuɗinka — wannan shi ne tsarin ajiyar ɓangare.

entries.englishValue: If too many people try to withdraw at the same time, the bank doesn't have enough cash to pay everyone. That's a bank run — and it can cause banks to collapse entirely.
entries.targetTranslation: Idan mutane da yawa suka yi ƙoƙarin cire kuɗi a lokaci ɗaya, bankin ba shi da isasshen kuɗi don biyan kowa. Wannan shi ne gudun banki — kuma yana iya halaka bankin gaba ɗaya.

entries.englishValue: Accepting Bitcoin at your business doesn't have to complicate your accounting. Here's the short version — plus the tools and pros to make it painless.
entries.targetTranslation: Karɓar Bitcoin a kasuwancinka ba sai ya rikitar da lissafin kuɗinka ba. Ga ɗan gajeren bayani — tare da kayan aiki da ƙwararru waɗanda za su sa shi ba mai zafi ba.

entries.englishValue: If you already accept cash or card, adding Bitcoin to your business books is simpler than it looks. You have two paths: auto-convert every Bitcoin payment to dollars the moment it arrives (no new accounting needed), or keep some as Bitcoin (a few extra numbers to track).
entries.targetTranslation: Idan ka riga ka karɓi tsabar kuɗi ko katuna, ƙara Bitcoin a lissafin kuɗin kasuwancinka ya fi sauƙi fiye da yadda kake tsammani. Kana da hanyoyi biyu: canja kowane biyan Bitcoin ta atomatik zuwa dala da zarar an karɓa (babu sabon lissafi), ko riƙe wani ɓangaren a Bitcoin (kana buƙatar bin wasu ƙarin lambobi).

entries.englishValue: This guide walks you through both — so you can pick the one that fits your business and start accepting Bitcoin with confidence.
entries.targetTranslation: Wannan jagorar tana bita kan hanyoyi biyu — don ka zaɓi wadda ta dace da kasuwancinka kuma ka fara karɓar Bitcoin da ƙarfin gwiwa.

entries.englishValue: The easy path: auto-convert to dollars
entries.targetTranslation: Hanya mai sauƙi: canja ta atomatik zuwa dala

entries.englishValue: That's it. The underlying math is identical to how any other appreciating or depreciating asset is accounted for.
entries.targetTranslation: Shi ke nan. Ainihin lissafi suna kama da kowane kadara wadda ke tashi ko faɗuwa.

entries.englishValue: Accept payments with lower fees, get paid instantly, and reach millions of new customers — with zero contracts and zero hidden costs.
entries.targetTranslation: Karɓi biyan kuɗi tare da ƙananan kuɗi, saitawa nan take kuma kai miliyoyin sabbin abokan ciniki — babu kwangila ko farashi a ɓoye.

entries.englishValue: Bitcoin gives your business a faster, cheaper, more private way to get paid. No middlemen. No chargebacks. No contracts. Just money that settles in seconds, directly from your customers to you.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin yana ba da hanya wa kasuwancinka don karɓar biyan kuɗi waɗanda suka fi sauri, sauƙi da sirri. Babu 'yan tsaka. Babu dawowar katuna. Babu kwangila. Kuɗi kawai wanda ke biya cikin daƙiƙa, kai tsaye daga abokin ciniki zuwa gareka.

entries.englishValue: You'll receive your free 'Bitcoin Accepted Here' stickers in 2 to 4 weeks, in a plain white envelope with 3 stickers inside.

entries.englishValue: If 3 stickers aren't enough for your business, feel free to request another free pack — or order in bulk from the same printer we use.

entries.englishValue: Let your customers know you accept Bitcoin. Order a free pack of 'Bitcoin Accepted Here' stickers to put up at your business.

entries.englishValue: Free 'Bitcoin Accepted Here' stickers

entries.englishValue: Accepting Bitcoin is only half the job — your customers also need to know that you do. These small 'Bitcoin Accepted Here' stickers are designed to stick on your front door, register, menu, or anywhere else customers will see them before they pay.
entries.targetTranslation: Karɓar Bitcoin rabin aiki ne — abokan cinikinka suna buƙatar sani shi ma. An ƙera ƙananan labaru “Bitcoin Accepted Here” don sa a ƙofar gaba, a wurin sayarwa, a kan menu ko ko'ina abokan cinikinka za su gan su kafin su biya.

entries.englishValue: We'll mail you a free pack anywhere in the USA or Canada, or you can print your own anywhere in the world.

entries.englishValue: You can print your own 'Bitcoin Accepted Here' stickers, no matter where you live. Click your language below to download the sticker files and printing instructions.

entries.englishValue: All Bitcoin wallets are interoperable — pick the one that fits your business. Free, instant settlement, no chargebacks.
entries.targetTranslation: Duk walat na Bitcoin suna aiki tare — zaɓi wanda ya dace da kasuwancinka. Kyauta, saitawa nan take, babu dawowar katuna.

entries.englishValue: Bitcoin wallets are free. Pick one that fits your business — in-person, online, or invoice-based — and start accepting Bitcoin in minutes.
entries.targetTranslation: Walat na Bitcoin kyauta ne. Zaɓi wanda ya dace da kasuwancinka — a shago, akan layi ko ta hanyar biya — kuma fara karɓar Bitcoin a cikin minti ɗaya.

entries.englishValue: Wallets for invoice-based businesses
entries.targetTranslation: Walat ga kasuwanci da ke aika biyan kuɗi ga abokan ciniki

entries.englishValue: If you invoice clients (consulting, freelancing, B2B services), use a wallet built around invoicing. Your client pays a Bitcoin invoice in a couple of clicks.
entries.targetTranslation: Idan kana aika biyan kuɗi ga abokan ciniki (shawarwari, aiki kyauta, ayyukan B2B), yi amfani da walat da aka gina a kewayen biyan kuɗi. Abokin ciniki yana biyan biyan Bitcoin a cikin danna kaɗan.

entries.englishValue: Wallets for businesses with multiple employees
entries.targetTranslation: Walat ga kasuwanci da ke da ƙungiyoyin ma'aikata

entries.englishValue: If you have a team taking payments at the register, choose a wallet that supports multiple employee logins — so every employee gets their own PIN and you keep a clean audit trail of who took which payment.
entries.targetTranslation: Idan kana da ƙungiya da ke yin sayarwa a wurin sayarwa, zaɓi walat da ke ɗaukar shiga ma'aikata da yawa — don kowane ma'aikaci yana da PIN ɗinsa kuma ka kiyaye rikodi mai bayyane na wanda ya karɓa kowane biyan.

entries.englishValue: Wallets for online businesses
entries.targetTranslation: Walat ga kasuwanci akan layi

entries.englishValue: Selling on a website? These wallets plug into your online store and accept Bitcoin from any customer, anywhere in the world — no chargebacks, no merchant account required.
entries.targetTranslation: Kana sayarwa akan layi? Waɗannan walat suna haɗawa da shagonka akan layi kuma suna karɓar Bitcoin daga kowane abokin ciniki a duniya — babu dawowar katuna kuma babu buƙatar asusun ɗan kasuwa.

entries.englishValue: Wallets for individually-owned businesses
entries.targetTranslation: Walat ga kasuwanci na mutum ɗaya

entries.englishValue: If you run a shop, café, studio, or service on your own, any of these wallets will work. Pick based on whether you want to keep payments in Bitcoin or auto-convert part of each payment to your local currency.
entries.targetTranslation: Idan kana gudanar da shago, kafe, ɗakin studio ko sabis kai kaɗai, kowane ɗayan waɗannan walat zai yi aiki. Zaɓi bisa ga ko kana son riƙe biyan kuɗi a Bitcoin ko canja ɓangare na kowane biyan ta atomatik zuwa kuɗin gida.

entries.englishValue: Strike Business lets you accept Bitcoin and Lightning payments with zero fees and instant settlement. Supports in-person, online, and invoice-based payments with optional auto-conversion to your local currency.
entries.targetTranslation: Strike Business yana ba ka damar karɓar biyan Bitcoin da Lightning tare da kuɗi sifili da saitawa nan take. Yana goyan bayan biyan a shago, akan layi da ta hanyar biya, tare da canja atomatik zaɓi zuwa kuɗin gida.

entries.englishValue: Lower fees, more for the business
entries.targetTranslation: Ƙananan kuɗi, ƙari ga kasuwanci

entries.englishValue: Bitcoin payments skip the banks and credit card companies that take 2–3% from every sale. The business keeps more of what you pay — which often means better prices and better service for you.
entries.targetTranslation: Biyan kuɗin Bitcoin yana wuce bankunan da kamfanonin katuna waɗanda ke cajin 2-3% akan kowane sayarwa. Kasuwancin yana riƙe ƙari na abin da kake biya — wanda yake nufin galibi farashi mai kyau da sabis mafi kyau a gare ka.

entries.englishValue: Instant settlement, no chargebacks
entries.targetTranslation: Saitawa nan take, babu dawowar katuna

entries.englishValue: Bitcoin payments settle in seconds, directly from your wallet to the business. There's no waiting days for a bank to release funds, and no costly chargeback disputes — so the business can focus on serving customers instead of fighting fraud.
entries.targetTranslation: Biyan kuɗin Bitcoin yana biya cikin daƙiƙa, kai tsaye daga walat ɗinka zuwa kasuwanci. Babu jinkirin kwanaki kafin banki ya saki kuɗi, kuma babu rikice-rikicen dawowar katuna masu tsada — wanda yake nufin kasuwancin zai iya mai da hankali kan abokan cinikinsa maimakon yaƙi da yaudara.

entries.englishValue: Free to accept, open to everyone
entries.targetTranslation: Karɓa kyauta, mai buɗewa ga kowa

entries.englishValue: There are no contracts, monthly fees, or setup costs for a business to accept Bitcoin. And millions of Bitcoin users around the world actively seek out merchants that accept it — giving this business free exposure to new customers.
entries.targetTranslation: Babu kwangila, kuɗin wata-wata ko kuɗin farawa ga kasuwanci don karɓar Bitcoin. Kuma miliyoyin masu amfani da Bitcoin a duk faɗin duniya suna neman 'yan kasuwa da ke karɓar shi — abin da ke ba wannan kasuwancin nuni kyauta ga sabbin abokan ciniki.

entries.englishValue: Run a business and want to start accepting Bitcoin?
entries.targetTranslation: Kana da kasuwanci kuma kana son fara karɓar Bitcoin?

entries.englishValue: See how it works →
entries.targetTranslation: Gano yadda yake aiki →

entries.englishValue: Why Bitcoin is great for this business
entries.targetTranslation: Me yasa Bitcoin yake da kyau ga wannan kasuwancin

entries.englishValue: Accepting Bitcoin lets a business keep more of every sale, get paid instantly with no chargebacks, and reach a global audience of Bitcoin users — all with zero contracts and zero monthly fees.
entries.targetTranslation: Ta hanyar karɓar Bitcoin, wannan kasuwancin yana riƙe ƙari akan kowane sayarwa, yana biya nan take ba tare da dawowar katuna ba kuma yana isa ga masu sauraron duniya na masu amfani da Bitcoin — duk ba tare da kwangila ko kuɗin wata-wata ba.

entries.englishValue: Bitcoin isn't just useful at the cash register — it's a better form of money that protects your savings, your privacy, and your freedom to transact. Here's a quick overview.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin ba kawai mai amfani ne a wurin sayarwa ba — wani nau'i ne na kuɗi mafi kyau wanda ke kare ajiyarka, sirrinka da 'yancin ma'amalarka. Ga gajeren bayani.

entries.englishValue: You just scanned a Bitcoin Accepted Here sticker. Here's why that's great news — for this business, and for you.
entries.targetTranslation: Kawai ka duba labari na “Bitcoin Accepted Here”. Ga me yasa wannan labari ne mai kyau — ga wannan kasuwancin da kuma a gare ka.

entries.englishValue: The business you're at accepts Bitcoin — a modern, open-source payment network that anyone can use, anywhere in the world, without banks or middlemen taking a cut.
entries.targetTranslation: Kasuwancin da kake a ciki yana karɓar Bitcoin — hanyar sadarwa ta zamani, mai buɗaɗɗen tushe da kowa, ko'ina, zai iya amfani da ita, ba tare da bankuna da 'yan tsaka suna ɗaukar rabonsu ba.

entries.englishValue: Below is the short version of why accepting Bitcoin is good for this business, plus why using Bitcoin is good for you as a customer.
entries.targetTranslation: Ƙasa akwai ɗan gajeren bayani na me yasa yake da kyau ga wannan kasuwancin karɓar Bitcoin, da me yasa yake da kyau a gare ka kamar abokin ciniki amfani da Bitcoin.

entries.englishValue: Flyers are one of the easiest ways to introduce Bitcoin to your community. Download a free printable Bitcoin flyer, print as many copies as you'd like, and post them on community boards, in coffee shops, at meetups, or anywhere else people gather.
entries.targetTranslation: Takardu na ɗaya daga cikin hanyoyi mafi sauƙi don kawo Bitcoin a al'ummarka. Saukar da takardar Bitcoin ɗinmu kyauta, yi kwafi da yawa kamar yadda kake so kuma rataye su a allunan sanarwa, a kafe, a tarurruka ko ko'ina mutane suka taru.

entries.englishValue: Each flyer includes a compelling headline and a QR code that sends curious readers to bitcoin.rocks to learn more.
entries.targetTranslation: Kowace takarda tana da kanun jagora mai jan hankali da lambar QR da ke kawo masu karatu masu sha'awa zuwa bitcoin.rocks don ƙarin koyo.

entries.englishValue: Unlike stickers, flyers can be printed on demand from anywhere in the world — all you need is a printer and a few minutes.
entries.targetTranslation: Ba kamar labaru ba, takardu za a iya buga su a kan buƙata daga ko'ina a duniya — kana buƙatar firinta da minti kaɗan kawai.

entries.englishValue: bitcoin.rocks is a free, open-source project licensed under the MIT License. Our mission is to accelerate Bitcoin adoption through education — and we can't do it alone.

entries.englishValue: Whether you're a developer, designer, writer, or translator, there's a way for you to help. We especially welcome contributors who can translate our content into more languages so more people around the world can learn about Bitcoin in their native tongue.
entries.targetTranslation: Ko kana mai haɓakawa, mai zane, marubuci ko mai fassara, akwai hanya don taimakawa. entries.englishValue: Nostr clients are free apps that let you read and post on the Nostr network. All of them are interoperable — you can switch clients anytime and keep your followers and content.
entries.targetTranslation: Kiran Nostr ne aikace-aikacen kyauta waɗanda ke ba ka damar karantawa da rubutu a hanyar sadarwar Nostr. Suna duka aiki tare — za ka iya canja kiran a kowane lokaci kuma ka riƙe mabiyan ka da abun cikin ka.

entries.englishValue: Nostr is a new decentralized protocol for communicating online — no single company controls it, Bitcoin zaps are built in, and you can move between apps without losing your followers.
entries.targetTranslation: Nostr sabon yarjejeniya ce mara tsakiya don sadarwa akan layi — babu wani kamfani da ke mallakar ta, akwai zaps na Bitcoin a ciki, kuma za ka iya komawa daga aikace-aikace zuwa aikace-aikace ba tare da rasa mabiyan ka ba.

entries.englishValue: What is Nostr?
entries.targetTranslation: Menene Nostr?

entries.englishValue: Nostr is similar to email: no one owns the protocol, anyone can build an app on top of it, and you can pick whichever app you like best. Unlike Twitter or Facebook, there's no central company that can censor, deplatform, or deboost you.
entries.targetTranslation: Nostr yana aiki kamar imel: babu wani da ke mallakar yarjejeniyar, kowa zai iya gina aikace-aikace akan ta kuma ka zaɓi wanda kake fi so. Ba kamar Twitter ko Facebook ba, babu kamfani na tsakiya da zai iya yi maka takunkumi, hana ka ko iyakance ka.

entries.englishValue: Nostr is a new protocol that lets you communicate online without fear of censorship, deplatforming, or deboosting.
entries.targetTranslation: Nostr sabon yarjejeniya ce wadda ke ba ka damar yin sadarwa akan layi ba tare da tsoron takunkumi, hani ko ƙuntatawa ba.

entries.englishValue: Platforms like Twitter and Facebook are controlled by a single company, but no one controls the Nostr protocol.
entries.targetTranslation: Dandali kamar Twitter da Facebook ana sarrafa su ne ta kamfani guda, amma babu wani da ke sarrafa yarjejeniyar Nostr.

entries.englishValue: Freedom to move
entries.targetTranslation: Kyauta a komawa

entries.englishValue: Nostr is similar to email. No one controls the email protocol, and anyone can build a client (like Gmail, Hotmail, etc.) on top of it.
entries.targetTranslation: Nostr yana aiki kamar imel. Babu wani ke kula da yarjejeniyar imel, kuma kowa zai iya gina kiran akan ta (kamar Gmail, Hotmail, da sauransu).

entries.englishValue: No one controls the Nostr protocol either, and anyone can build a client (like Damus, Amethyst, etc.) on top of it.
entries.targetTranslation: Babu wani da ke sarrafa yarjejeniyar Nostr ko, kuma kowa zai iya gina kiran akan ta (kamar Damus, Amethyst, da sauransu).

entries.englishValue: If you don't like how a certain client works, you can seamlessly move your Nostr account to another client without losing your followers or content.
entries.targetTranslation: Idan ba ka son yadda wani kiran ke aiki, za ka iya komawa da asusun Nostr ɗinka zuwa wani kiran ba tare da rasa mabiyan ka ko abun ciki ba.

entries.englishValue: Bitcoin is built in
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin yana ciki

entries.englishValue: Bitcoin is built in natively to the Nostr protocol. If you see content you like, you can easily zap Bitcoin to someone as a thank you!
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin yana cikin yarjejeniyar Nostr. Lokacin da ka ga abun ciki da kake so, za ka iya aika “zap na Bitcoin” zuwa marubucin a sauƙaƙe a matsayin godiya.

entries.englishValue: On centralized platforms like Twitter and Facebook, the centralized company earns money from your content. But on open protocols like Nostr, you earn money from your content.
entries.targetTranslation: A dandali na tsakiya kamar Twitter da Facebook, kamfani na tsakiya yana samun kuɗi daga abun cikin ka. Amma a yarjejeniyar buɗewa kamar Nostr, kai ne ke samun kuɗi daga abun cikin ka.
